summary: Blank comment accepted by the server
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Log in as staff user in the task's group. 2. Send POST to the task detail URL with add_comment=Add Comment and comment-body empty or spaces (automated test M3-02; the browser form blocks this, so use the test or browser dev tools).
expected: Server rejects the blank comment; nothing saved; no email sent
actual: Blank comment saved and notification email sent
evidence: M3-02 automated failure output; screenshot of terminal
notes: views/task_detail.py handle_add_comment() has no server-side check; Comment.body is blank=True. Fix idea: strip and reject empty body before Comment.objects.create(); retest with M3-01 and M3-02.

summary: Search page returns HTTP 500 when opened without a query string
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Log in as a staff user who is not a superuser. 2. Open /todo/search/ with no ?q= parameter.
expected: Empty search page or a prompt to enter a term
actual: HTTP 500 server error (AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'filter')
evidence: Exploratory test output; browser screenshot of the error page
notes: views/search.py: found_tasks is None when request.GET is empty, then .filter() is called on it. Exploratory finding - not one of the 16 planned cases. Workaround: always enter a search term.
